faqs.question: How are Aaradhya Pandits vetted and certified?
faqs.answer: Every Purohit on Aaradhya undergoes a rigorous 4-tier verification protocol: (1) Identity and address verification with police background check, (2) Validation of degrees/titles (Shastri or Acharya) from accredited institutions such as Sampurnanand Sanskrit Vishwavidyalaya, (3) Audition of Vedic mantra recitation and shloka pronunciation, and (4) Personal interview focusing on punctuality, dignified conduct, and customer etiquette.

faqs.question: What is included in the Pure Organic Samagri Kit?
faqs.answer: Our Samagri kits are curated according to canonical Grihya Sutra manuals. They include certified Haridwar Gangajal, Bhimseni unadulterated camphor, 100% pure Gir Cow A2 ghee, hand-selected unblemished Akshat (rice), organic kumkum and turmeric, fresh mango/ashoka leaves, brass diya with cotton wicks, and consecrated Navagraha medicinal samidha sticks.

faqs.question: How does the 100% Sacred Escrow protection work?
faqs.answer: When you book a ceremony, your Dakshina is safely held in our escrow vault. The pandit does not receive payout until the puja is performed to your complete satisfaction and you confirm ritual completion. In the rare event of cancellation or Pandit no-show, a 100% immediate refund is processed to your original payment method.

faqs.question: Can we reschedule the Muhurat date or time if our family plans shift?
faqs.answer: Yes, absolutely. We understand that family schedules and astrological muhurats can require adjustments. You can reschedule your ceremony up to 24 hours prior to the scheduled Muhurat free of charge directly via your Aaradhya account or our 24/7 WhatsApp concierge.

faqs.question: What is the Digital Sankalp Patra and how do we access it?
faqs.answer: The Digital Sankalp Patra is an ornate Sanskrit certificate cryptographically generated upon the fulfillment of your ritual. It documents your family Gotra, the specific ceremony performed, conducting Purohit, and exact Vedic tithi. You can download it as a high-resolution PDF for framing or export it to Google/Apple Calendar for annual anniversary reminders.

faqs.question: Do you offer remote / e-Puja options for non-resident devotees?
faqs.answer: Yes. For families living outside India or unable to physically gather, our Acharyas conduct authentic remote Sankalp Pujas live from Varanasi (Kashi) or Haridwar. Consecrated dry prasad and sacred mauli threads are safely dispatched by international courier.
